apps.title: Upkeep Tips We Share With Mechanics
apps.intro: Our parts last longest when engines are looked after. Mechanics in Colombia tell us these habits make the biggest difference:
list: Change engine oil on schedule, more often in very dusty areas
Clean or replace air filters after running on unpaved roads
Let the engine idle briefly before switching off after a hot run
Check for oil leaks around gaskets during each service
Replace worn parts in matched sets where the design calls for it

faq_intro: Practical questions about engine parts for Colombian motocarros.
faqs: Why do some replacement parts fail early?
Parts that are slightly out of tolerance wear unevenly. Ours are machined to specification and checked before dispatch to avoid that.
Does dust really shorten engine life?
Yes. Dust that gets past a clogged filter acts like an abrasive inside the engine, so regular filter care matters.
Can better parts improve fuel use?
Correctly sized parts help the engine run efficiently, especially when combined with good maintenance.
Do you make parts to drawing?
Yes. Our engineers check feasibility before production.

Yes, labelled by model in one container.
